introduction.p: Here are some practice exercises with multiplication and signed numbers. The expectation is that you can make these calculations without a calculator.

solution.p: Since 13\cdot2=26\text{,} and we are multiplying numbers of opposite signs, the answer is negative: -26\text{.}
Since 30\cdot50=1500\text{,} and we are multiplying numbers of opposite signs, the answer is negative: -1500\text{.}
Since 12\cdot7=84\text{,} and we are multiplying numbers of the same sign, the answer is positive: 84\text{.}
